intro:
Are you ready for an epic adventure? Look no further than Super Jake's Adventure – Jump & Run, the best 2D adventure game to hit the browser scene in 2020. This free game is a masterclass in game design, combining tight controls, addictive gameplay, and a visually stunning jungle world that will transport you to a world of excitement and danger. At its core, Super Jake's Adventure is a platformer, but it's so much more than that. You'll play as Super Jake, the incredible jumping Jack and leprechaun, as he battles his way through hordes of jumpy monsters to save his brothers and restore peace to the jungle world.

In Super Jake's Adventure, you'll be tasked with navigating treacherous terrain, dodging deadly obstacles, and collecting strawberries to boost your power-ups. But that's not all – you'll also need to smash monsters on the run, earning coins and fighting your way to the final showdown with the boss who masterminds the invasion. With its addictive gameplay, beautiful visuals, and epic storyline, Super Jake's Adventure is a game that will keep you coming back for more.

So what sets Super Jake's Adventure apart from other platformers? For starters, the game's controls are incredibly tight, making it easy to jump, run, and smash your way through even the toughest levels. But it's not just the controls – the game's design is also incredibly clever, with clever level design, hidden secrets, and a variety of power-ups to keep you on your toes. And with its beautiful, vibrant graphics, you'll feel like you're right there in the jungle, dodging deadly traps and battling fearsome foes.

But don't just take our word for it – Super Jake's Adventure has already won the hearts of players around the world. With its free-to-play model and addictive gameplay, this game is a must-play for anyone who loves adventure games. So what are you waiting for? Join the adventure and see for yourself why Super Jake's Adventure is the best 2D adventure game of the year.
